# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When the EMA ribbon compresses (narrow width) and then breaks out with above-average volume, the ensuing move often continues, offering a long entry. This edge exists because ribbon compression indicates low volatility and equilibrium, and a volume-filtered breakout suggests institutional participation and momentum initiation.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: 
- Ribbon width = |EMA8 - EMA21| (absolute difference)
- Compression: ribbon width < 0.07 * ATR(14) for two consecutive 5-minute bars
- Breakout: next bar closes above the high of the second compression bar with volume > 1.5 * average volume of the prior 20 bars
- Enter long at the close of the breakout bar

Exit shape:
- Stop: low of the second compression bar (chart-stop)
- Target: 2.0 * ATR above entry price OR trail 20% off the highest close after entry (whichever is hit first)
- Regime filters: VIX between 15-30, time 09:45-14:00 ET, avoid lunch chop (11:30-12:30) unless volume confirmation is strong (volume > 2.0 * average volume of prior 20 bars)
